en.headline: MegaBox screens NBA China Games from its Kowloon Bay roof
en.dek: The mall will show the Mavericks against the Rockets at Mega Sky on Friday night and again on Sunday afternoon.
body: MegaBox said it will screen the NBA China Games on the Mega Sky garden at level 18, showing the Dallas Mavericks against the Houston Rockets.

The mall said the first session is on Friday at 7:30pm and the second on Sunday at 5:30pm. The games themselves are being played in Macao. Admission is by a ticket redeemed at the ground-floor concierge.

Mega Club members who spend 1,000 dollars or more the same day by electronic payment at MegaBox shops can redeem a ticket while stocks last. Redemption opened on 29 September and runs from noon to 10pm. Cash receipts are not accepted, the mall said.

MegaBox said Friday attendees will receive a Mavericks keychain, a set of NBA China Games pins, a notebook and stickers, and Sunday attendees a Rockets phone strap with the same other items. It described Mega Sky as a newly opened sky garden.

zh.headline: 九龍灣MegaBox天台直播觀賞NBA中國賽
zh.dek: 商場表示，周五晚上及周日下午於十八樓Mega Sky轉播獨行俠對火箭，入場券須於地下禮賓部換領。
body: MegaBox表示，將於新建的十八樓空中花園Mega Sky轉播NBA中國賽，對賽為達拉斯獨行俠對侯斯頓火箭。賽事本身在澳門舉行。
商場公布，首場為周五晚上七時三十分，次場為周日下午五時三十分。入場須先換領門票，換領地點為地下禮賓部。
Mega Club會員於MegaBox商戶以電子支付單日消費一千元或以上，可換領一張門票，換完即止。換領由九月二十九日開始，每日中午十二時至晚上十時。商場指現金收據不獲接納。
商場表示，周五到場人士可獲獨行俠匙扣、NBA中國賽襟章一套、筆記簿及貼紙；周日到場人士則獲火箭手機繩，其餘禮品相同。
